output_list.criticism: The price of the token is set by the contract owner, which can be manipulated by the attacker. The attacker can set the sellPrice and buyPrice to a higher or lower value, effectively increasing or decreasing the token's price. This will result in the attacker owning a majority of the tokens. The attacker can use the function buy() to purchase the tokens at the manipulated price. The function sell() can be used by the attacker to sell the tokens at the manipulated price.
